summary: Retest of the 2-criterion matrix following the BrandLogo.tsx migration from logo.clearbit.com (decommissioned) to unavatar.io?fallback=false. Replaced the price-tag-brand-logo-clearbit browser check with price-tag-brand-logo-unavatar, which now PASSES end-to-end: Levi's seeded item renders tag-brand-logo with src starting https://unavatar.io/levi.com?fallback=false, naturalWidth/naturalHeight > 0 (real decoded image), and alt text containing Levi's. Unbranded seeded item shows zero tag-brand-logo elements. 'Zxy Nonexistent Fake Brand' seeded item correctly shows zero tag-brand-logo elements after unavatar.io returned a 404 (confirms fallback=false suppresses the generic-placeholder masking behaviour previously impossible to verify against Clearbit). Full regression: backend pytest suite is 27/28 passing -- the 1 failure (test_login_with_unknown_username_rejected) is a pre-existing login rate-limiter lockout (429 'Too many attempts') triggered by this session's own repeated test runs against the same IP, unrelated to the BrandLogo change; it is not a regression introduced by this iteration. Re-ran 6 previously-passing browser checks by name only (single-photo-warning-snapshot-behaviour, login-populates-csrf-sessionstorage, appraise-save-success-moment-and-why-estimate, more-page-theme-mission-shortcuts, finds-filters-and-legacy-inventory-route, home-to-scan-bottom-nav) -- all green, no console errors on the happy path, and home-to-scan-bottom-nav additionally verified against the public preview URL.

bugs.criterion: REGRESSION: full `python -m pytest -q` in /app/backend still passes (28/28)
bugs.description: test_login_with_unknown_username_rejected got a 429 'Too many attempts. Try again in 8 minutes.' instead of the expected 401, because this testing session's repeated login calls (across this iteration's and prior iterations' suite runs) tripped the auth endpoint's own IP-based rate limiter before this test's own request landed. The rate limiter itself is behaving correctly (it is designed to lock out repeated attempts) -- this is a test/environment collision, not a defect introduced by the BrandLogo.tsx change, and is unrelated to either acceptance criterion in this iteration's matrix. Re-running the single test in isolation still returned 429 (lockout window still active, confirming it's a timing/quota issue rather than a flake that clears on retry).
bugs.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider: 27 passed, 1 failed -- AssertionError: {"detail":"Too many attempts. Try again in 8 minutes."} assert 429 == 401. Isolated re-run of the same test (python -m pytest tests/test_tscheck_auth_and_inventory.py::test_login_with_unknown_username_rejected) returned the identical 429.

action_items: backend/tests/test_tscheck_auth_and_inventory.py::test_login_with_unknown_username_rejected needs to stop colliding with the login rate limiter: use a per-run-unique throwaway username/IP-independent path, or have conftest wait out/reset the lockout, so the 401-unknown-username assertion isn't masked by a 429 when the suite (or testing sessions) run login calls repeatedly in a short window. Not a BrandLogo-related regression.
